title: Unify recommendations into compact product cards
summary: Consistent photo and information panels, shorter display titles and aligned prices.

changes.detail: Unified each card with a fine border and muted information panel; reduced image height and row gaps.
Related display titles omit repeated leading brands and spaced dash suffixes while full original names remain in accessibility labels and product data.
Removed repeated NEW badges from related products; retained genuine discounts and wishlist actions.
Reserved consistent title and old-price space; emphasized numeric prices with smaller localized currency and omitted zero fractional digits for integer amounts.
